name: ERTH 2310E
title: Creating and Sustaining National Parks
description: (Also offered as GEOG 2310E.) Geologic processes that create the Earth’s iconic landscapes through the study of National Parks, Monuments, and Seashores. Plate tectonics, climate and biotic change, natural hazards, Earth materials and resources, environmental conservation, and the interactions between human society and the natural world.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
